answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond before it may trade, with the bond recorded as a public beacon that peers can inspect. If two identities are caught running the same cipher session or copying the same work, the bond of both is slashed and their anchor reputation is reset to zero. A single attacker must then fund a fresh bond for each fake identity, and a duplicate costs real money instead of a free re-registration, while honest agents recover their bond in full at the end of each epoch.
